notes.title: Farm Together 2 - Full release available now!
notes.notes:
Today we're releasing Farm Together 2, the farming experience that anyone can play!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/6860297/d1125bb8df0734a02d6bcd99c9466df705f8edae.jpg[/img]

We've made a huge effort to create a [b]fun and relaxed[/b] farming experience. We hope you have a good time playing it!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2418520/Farm_Together_2/

This couldn't have been done without the help of the community! We really want to thank you for the useful feedback that has helped shape the game during the whole year it's been on Early Access. We've done a total of [b]91 updates[/b] so far, polishing the game and adding new content. And this is just the beginning! Expect new things in the future, including free content updates and seasonal events.

The game will feature a 7-day 10% discount, which can be combined with additional discounts by getting it on a bundle if you already had the first game, or an even better discount if you own the whole Milkstone collection!

notes.title: Bugfix update - online issues
notes.notes:
Welcome back fellow investigators!

We've just uploaded a small bugfix update that should help with a specific issue regarding not being able to join online sessions. It took a while to find and fix (actually, over 2 years!), but better late than never, right?

notes.title: New update: More bugfixes!
notes.notes:
We've just released a new update for White Noise Online. 

[list]
[*]When finding online games, the ones that have already started are ignored (this was probably the most common reason for the network connection issues reported so far)
[*]Improved network connection protocol, now it should report failed connections faster
[*]Increased number of log messages on matchmaking errors.
[*]Moved game view a bit down to match characters size
[*]Fixed minor mouse cursor glitch
[/list]

notes.title: New update : Multiplayer bugfixes
notes.notes:
We've just released a new update for White Noise Online.

It's intended to fix all crashes reported so far, and tries to help us solve connection issues on future updates.

[list]
[*]Fixed frequent crash when starting a multiplayer game and some players had selected a random character.
[*]Fixed crash when a player joins a session mid-game and someone picks a tape.
[*]Increased time given to join a multiplayer lobby (trying to locate the problem with joining lobbies...)
[*]Lobby join errors are now a little more descriptive, to help us locate the root issue.
[/list]
